---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea, workflow improvement, or new capability for realntoffice
title: "feat: [Short descriptive summary of feature]"
labels: ["enhancement", "triage"]
assignees: []
---

## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of what problem this feature solves. (e.g., "When teams exceed 500 members on floor 3, finding an open focus booth requires manual scanning...").

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Explain how this fits into the virtual office workflow.

## Right Flow vs. Anti-Pattern Alignment
* **Right Flow Category**: [e.g., Ambient Spatial Presence, Ad-Hoc Huddle, Async Artifact, Spatial Interest Management]
* **Anti-Pattern Guard**: How does this proposal avoid the prohibited anti-patterns defined in `docs/RIGHT_AND_ANTI_PATTERNS.md` (e.g., zero employee surveillance, zero O(N^2) socket floods, zero forced video marathons)?

## Alternative Approaches Considered
A description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Target Organizational Scale
- [ ] Micro Scale (1 to 15 members)
- [ ] Mid Scale (15 to 150 members)
- [ ] Enterprise Scale (150 to 10,000+ members)
